title: Urinary miRNA and microbiome in kidney transplant recipients with BK polyomavirus DNAemia: analysis code
description: Code for an independent reprocessing and integration of urinary small-RNA sequencing and shotgun metagenomics from 22 kidney transplant recipients (11 with BK polyomavirus DNAemia, 11 controls): SLURM/Apptainer read-processing pipeline (ERCC small-RNA QC, miRDeep2, MetaPhlAn 4, BKPyV/JCPyV DNA) and R analyses (DESeq2/edgeR, ALDEx2, Aitchison PERMANOVA, miRNA–genus correlations, figures). Accompanies a Brief Communication in Transplant Infectious Disease.
